method.description: Lexical/rendering divergence indicator; not a doctrinal truth score or majority vote.
method.normalization: case, punctuation, footnote markers, and common KJV archaisms normalized
method.public_ranking_guard: minimum 8 POB tokens and three length-compatible references

sources.bsb: Berean Standard Bible (Public Domain / CC0). bereanbible.com.
sources.asv: American Standard Version (1901; Public Domain). ebible.org/asv/.
sources.brenton: Brenton's translation of the Septuagint (1844/1851; Public Domain). ebible.org/eng-Brenton/.
sources.kjv: King James Version, ebible.org 2006 transcription (Public Domain in US).

pob.text: The elder[a], to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth—and not I alone[b], but also all who have come to know the truth—

spob.text: From the elder to the chosen lady[a] and her children, whom I love in truth.[b] I am not the only one who loves them. Everyone who has come to know the truth loves them too.

public_domain_references.bsb: The elder, To the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in the truth—and not I alone, but also all who know the truth—
public_domain_references.web: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,
public_domain_references.asv: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in truth; and not I only, but also all they that know the truth;
public_domain_references.kjv: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;

pob.text: because of the truth that remains in us and will be with us forever[a].

spob.text: We love you because the truth stays in us and will be with us forever.

public_domain_references.bsb: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever:
public_domain_references.web: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:
public_domain_references.asv: for the truth’s sake which abideth in us, and it shall be with us for ever:
public_domain_references.kjv: For the truth’s sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.

pob.text: Grace[a], mercy, and peace will be with us from God the Father and from Jesus the Messiah, the Father's Son[b], in truth and love.

spob.text: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us. They will come from God the Father and from Jesus the Messiah,[a] the Father's Son, in truth and love.

public_domain_references.bsb: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, will be with us in truth and love.
public_domain_references.web: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
public_domain_references.asv: Grace, mercy, peace shall be with us, from God the Father, and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
public_domain_references.kjv: Grace be with you, mercy, [and] peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

pob.text: I rejoiced greatly that I have found some of your children walking in the truth[b][a], just as we received a commandment from the Father.

spob.text: It gave me great joy to discover that some of your children are walking in the truth—living in keeping with the commandment we received from the Father.

public_domain_references.bsb: I was overjoyed to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father has commanded us.
public_domain_references.web: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.
public_domain_references.asv: I rejoice greatly that I have found [certain] of thy children walking in truth, even as we received commandment from the Father.
public_domain_references.kjv: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.

pob.text: And now I ask you[a], lady, not as though I were writing to you a new commandment, but the one we have had from the beginning: that we love one another.

spob.text: Now, lady[a], I ask you this: I am not writing you a new commandment, but the one we have had from the beginning—that we love one another.

public_domain_references.bsb: And now I urge you, dear lady—not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning—that we love one another.
public_domain_references.web: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
public_domain_references.asv: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote to thee a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
public_domain_references.kjv: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

pob.text: And this is love: that we walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment[a], just as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

spob.text: This is what love looks like: we walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment you heard from the beginning: you should walk in it.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the very commandment you have heard from the beginning, that you must walk in love.
public_domain_references.web: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.
public_domain_references.asv: And this is love, that we should walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, even as ye heard from the beginning, that ye should walk in it.
public_domain_references.kjv: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.

pob.text: For many deceivers have gone out into the world[a], those who do not confess Jesus the Messiah coming in the flesh[b]. This is the deceiver and the antichrist.

spob.text: For many deceivers have gone out into the world. They do not confess that Jesus is the Messiah[a] coming in the flesh[b]—as a real human being. Such a person is the deceiver and the antichrist.

public_domain_references.bsb: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, refusing to confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.
public_domain_references.web: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.
public_domain_references.asv: For many deceivers are gone forth into the world, [even] they that confess not that Jesus Christ cometh in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the antichrist.
public_domain_references.kjv: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.

pob.text: Watch yourselves[a], so that you may not lose what we have worked for, but may receive a full reward.

spob.text: Be on guard, so that you do not lose the results of our work, but receive the full reward.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be fully rewarded.
public_domain_references.web: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
public_domain_references.asv: Look to yourselves, that ye lose not the things which we have wrought, but that ye receive a full reward.
public_domain_references.kjv: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.

pob.text: Everyone who goes on ahead and does not remain in the teaching of Messiah does not have God[a]. The one who remains in the teaching[b], this one has both the Father and the Son.

spob.text: Anyone who moves on ahead and does not stay with the teaching of the Messiah does not have God.[a] But whoever stays with that teaching has both the Father and the Son.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in His teaching has both the Father and the Son.
public_domain_references.web: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
public_domain_references.asv: Whosoever goeth onward and abideth not in the teaching of Christ, hath not God: he that abideth in the teaching, the same hath both the Father and the Son.
public_domain_references.kjv: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.

pob.text: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your house, and do not say a greeting to him.

spob.text: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching,[a] do not welcome him into your home or greet him.

public_domain_references.bsb: If anyone comes to you but does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your home or even greet him.
public_domain_references.web: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,
public_domain_references.asv: If any one cometh unto you, and bringeth not this teaching, receive him not into [your] house, and give him no greeting:
public_domain_references.kjv: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into [your] house, neither bid him God speed:

pob.text: For the one who says to him[a], “Greetings,” shares in his evil works.

spob.text: For anyone who greets him this way[a] shares in his evil deeds.

public_domain_references.bsb: Whoever greets such a person shares in his evil deeds.
public_domain_references.web: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.
public_domain_references.asv: for he that giveth him greeting partaketh in his evil works.
public_domain_references.kjv: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.

pob.text: Though I have many things to write to you[a], I did not want to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come to you and speak face to face, so that your joy may be made complete.

spob.text: I have many things to write to you, but I did not want to write them on paper with ink. Instead, I hope to come to you and talk with you face to face, so that your joy[a] may be complete.

public_domain_references.bsb: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come and speak with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
public_domain_references.web: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.
public_domain_references.asv: Having many things to write unto you, I would not [write them] with paper and ink: but I hope to come unto you, and to speak face to face, that your joy may be made full.
public_domain_references.kjv: Having many things to write unto you, I would not [write] with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.

pob.text: The children of your chosen sister greet you.

spob.text: Your chosen sister’s children send you their greetings.

public_domain_references.bsb: The children of your elect sister send you greetings.
public_domain_references.web: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
public_domain_references.asv: The children of thine elect sister salute thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
